metadata.title: What the ALMA Release of 6 November 2026 Can Test: Pre-Data Predictions for U4_28473 and U4_27928 (Working Note)
metadata.description:
Working note v1.4, 4 November 2026. AI-assisted; not peer reviewed. Kappa = 1/2 is fitted; the theory is not closed.

Pre-data numerical predictions for U4_28473 and the serendipitous U4_27928 reading in ALMA programme 2024.1.00100.L are preserved unchanged. The archive metadata cited in the note list 6 November 2026 as the release date; dates and rights can change. U4_28473 primarily constrains the baryonic mass budget rather than a0(z). One disc excludes no model. Route N is retired and retained only as historical information.

Version 1.4 corrects the scoring implementation to compare all three fitting starts, documents the retained fixed 8.9% mock uncertainty floor without claiming signal-to-noise-matched calibration, and clarifies conditional scorecard outcomes. New mock validation is recorded separately from the historical forecasts. Frozen criteria, seals, prediction tables and historical numerical outputs are protected by full SHA-256 checks. This metadata file prepares a possible new version; it does not record a deposit.

AI assistance: Anthropic Claude (analysis, review, drafting); OpenAI Codex (v1.4 implementation audit, repairs and validation).
